name: taskflow-monorepo
description: TaskFlow - Collaborative Task and Project Management Platform

scripts.dev: concurrently -n "backend,frontend" -c "blue,green" "npm --prefix backend run dev" "npm --prefix web run dev"
scripts.install:all: npm install && npm --prefix backend install && npm --prefix web install
scripts.test: npm --prefix backend run test && npm --prefix web run test
scripts.build: npm --prefix web install && npm --prefix web run build

author: TaskFlow Team
